prompt: Build a instagram clone app which has a post section which can add post, edit post, likes post, saves the likes and dislikes in a form of array, and a comment section, this basic thing should be there

tasks.task: Create `server.js` with Express app listening on port 3000.
Create `data.js` to store in-memory posts and comments arrays.
Create `posts.js` with Express routes for posts CRUD operations.
Create `comments.js` with Express routes for comment operations.
Create `frontend/index.html` with basic structure and root div.
Create `frontend/style.css` for styling posts and comments sections.
Create `frontend/app.js` to manage all frontend logic and interactions.

files.explanation: This file sets up an Express server, defines routes, and serves the frontend folder statically.
This file stores in-memory posts and comments arrays.
This file defines Express routes for posts CRUD operations.
This file defines Express routes for comment operations.
This file is the main entry point for the frontend application.
This file styles the posts and comments sections.
This file manages all frontend logic and interactions.
